[Full Marks Mode]: Shifts targeting to the enemy with the highest health. Consecutive attacks on the same enemy increases damage by ($fmm_value)% (Max of 3 stacks). Each attack in "Full Marks Mode" consumes 1 Focus stack, once all 18 stacks of Focus have been consumed, switches back to "Revision Mode". When skill is used in "Full Marks Mode", increases damage by ($value_set1)% and both rate of fire and accuracy by ($value_set2)% for 6 seconds. Additionally, increases damage received by 30% and reduces own movement speed by 30%.

rpk-16.name: Wits of the Silver Fox
rpk-16.text: [Passive]: Once ammo in current clip is depleted, enters AR Mode, reducing own rate of fire by 40% while increasing own accuracy by ($pass_acc_value)% and movement speed by 150%. [Active]: Reloads and switches back to MG Mode. Reload time is a fixed 1 second and reloading clears all stat changes from AR Mode while increasing own damage by ($dam_value)% for ($duration) seconds.

ak-15.name: Eye of the White Mastiff
ak-15.text: [Passive]: Has a 15% chance to trigger Rage when attacking. While Rage is active, every hit will deal an extra hit of ($all_value)% additional damage for 3 seconds. [Active]: On skill activation, begins monitoring all enemy units. When attacking a monitored unit, increases damage, accuracy and critical hit rate by ($all_value)%, if being attacked by a monitored unit, increases own evasion by ($all_value)% as well. Monitoring lasts 6 seconds. While monitoring is active, gains +5 stacks of Overload for every 2 seconds monitoring is active. Additionally, grants +1 stack of Overload for each monitored enemy unit. Upon reaching ($overload) stacks of Overload, Clears all current Overload stacks and ends active skills effect while reducing own rate of fire and accuracy by 20% for 5 seconds. This debuff can coexist with Monitoring, however skill cannot be reactivated while debuff is present.

ak-15.name: Eye of the White Mastiff
ak-15.text: [Passive]: Has a 15% chance to trigger Rage when attacking. While Rage is active, every hit will deal an extra hit of ($all_value)% additional damage for 3 seconds. [Active]: On skill activation, begins monitoring all enemy units. When attacking a monitored unit, increases damage, accuracy and critical hit rate by ($all_value)%, if being attacked by a monitored unit, increases own evasion by ($all_value)% as well. Monitoring lasts 6 seconds. While monitoring is active, gains +5 stacks of Overload for every 2 seconds monitoring is active. Additionally, grants +1 stack of Overload for each monitored enemy unit. Upon reaching ($overload) stacks of Overload, Clears all current Overload stacks and ends active skills effect while reducing own rate of fire and accuracy by 20% for 5 seconds. This debuff can coexist with Monitoring, however skill cannot be reactivated while debuff is present.

ak-15.name: Blood-Curdling Howl
ak-15.text: When she monitors more than 5 targets or loses a Dummy-link, she becomes immune to all damage for 2 seconds and retaliates against the enemy unit with the highest damage stat, dealing ($dam_value1)x guaranteed damage that scales with Dummy-Links and ignores shields and armour. Retaliation damage is doubled when Rage is active. When only DEFY members are present on the battlefield, activating Eye of the White Mastiff will cause her to taunt enemy units and reduces incoming damage taken by ($dam_value2)% for ($duration) seconds.

webley.name: Linked Order
webley.text:
When placed in an echelon member slot, increase the echelon leader's damage and ROF by ($idle_value)% for ($duration) seconds, while reducing the current cooldown time of the leader's skill by ($lead_value)%.
When placed in the echelon leader position or if the leader is absent, raise all allies' damage by ($cdr_value)%, lasting for 5 seconds.
[EQ Passive]: When equipped with "Cloak of Glory", this unit cannot suffer dummy link losses within 10 seconds of a battle starting.

cf05.name: Butter Cream
cf05.text: While the skill is active, reduce every instance damage taken by ($dam_value) points for ($duration) seconds. [EQ Passive]: When equipped with "Panda Dangle", every instance of damage taken by enemies is increased by 50 points while the skill is active.

sl8.name: Shimmering Waves
sl8.text: Raise self ROF by ($rof_value)%, and buff self depending on the number of gun types on the buff tiles. For every different gun type on the tiles, gain a stack of ($pass_value)% damage increase lasting for ($time_value) seconds, with a maximum of 3 stacks. [EQ Passive]: When equipped with .233 Competition Cartridge, every different gun type on buff tiles additionally increases rate of fire by 10%, stacking up to 3 times. This effect lasts until the current battle ends.

m82.name: Charge Focus
m82.text:
Increase damage by ($damage_value)% and rate of fire by ($rof_value)% for ($time_value) seconds.
[EQ Passive:] After equipping VM Goggles, all allies stats are increased by an additional 5% for the duration of the skill.

vepr.name: Steel Blue Timpani
vepr.text: Increases the damage, accuracy and rate of fire of allies present on her tiles by ($buff_value)% for ($time_value) seconds.

hsm10.name: Survival Instinct
hsm10.text: Increases evasion by ($eva_value)% and armour rating by ($armour_value)% for ($time_value) seconds.

mas-38.name: Mobility Focus
mas-38.text: Increases damage by ($dam_value)% and evasion by ($eva_value)% and for ($duration) seconds.

defender.name: Blossoming Fang
defender.text: [Passive]: Every attack expends all ammunition and deals 8 instances of damage to the nearest target (knockback chance will only be checked 1 times, damage does not stack with Slug or Birdshot ammo). Damage falls off the further away the target is and increases the closer it is, to a maximum of ($dam_value)x damage. Reload time is also decreased by ($reload)s. [EQ Passive]: When “20-gauge Custom Slug Rounds” are equipped, the active skill is modified: Initial CD 0s, CD 8s, and after the skill is activated, the next attack is a guaranteed hit.

hp-35.name: Berserk Accompaniment
hp-35.text: [Passive]: When enemies are under negative status effects, damage taken is increased by ($pass_amp)%. When allies are under negative status effects, damage taken is reduced by ($pass_reduce)%. Passive is always active during night battles. [Active]: Increases the damage dealt to all enemies by ($amp_value)% for ($duration) seconds.

saf.name: Shockwave Explosion
saf.text:
Throw a hand grenade across a distance of 5 units ahead of self, dealing ($dam_value)x damage to enemies in a 2.5 radius and inflicting knockback of 3 units.
When in the middle row, enemies are knocked to both sides. When in the top or bottom row, enemies are knocked into the center. This knockback effect does not affect units which are attacking or using skills.
[EQ Passive]: After the SAF chip is equipped, grenade damage is increased by 100% and enemies are stunned for 3 seconds after being knocked back.

tabuk.name: Symmetrical Adjustment
tabuk.text: Increases damage by ($dam_value)% for ($duration) seconds. While skill is active, prioritise enemies that are within 5 units range of self and deal additional ($pass_value)% damage to them.

ak-alfa.name: Blazar
ak-alfa.text:
[Active]: Raise self damage by ($dam_value)% for ($duration) seconds. While the skill is active, prioritize attacking the closest enemy units directly ahead of self.
[Passive]: Damage against enemy units in front of self is increased by ($pass_value)%.
[EQ Passive]: After equipping the TLL enhanced rounds, Blazar's damage buff will not be cleansed and damage dealt to the unit directly in front is increased by 5% for every type of stat buff on this unit.

zb-26.name: Perfect Chain
zb-26.text:
[Active]: Immediately complete a special reload and obtain ($clipsize) additional rounds. When using additional rounds, increase damage and accuracy by ($buff_value)%.
[Passive]: After each reload, grant 1 round to other machine guns in the echelon and reduce self reload time by 20%, to a maximum of 60%.
[EQ Passive]: When equipped with 8mm Mauser Special Rounds, reloading also increases damage of all machine guns in the echelon by 6% for 10 seconds.

c14.name: Assault Focus
c14.text: Increases rate of fire by ($rof_value)% for ($time_value) seconds.

wkp.name: Nightfire
wkp.text: [Passive]: Deals ($pass_value)x dummy-link-ignoring damage to the attacked target in a 1.5 unit radius. [Active]: During night battles, prioritize targets which have not attacked yet, checking enemies for ($duration1) seconds. Enemies damaged by this skill have their evasion decreased by ($debuff)% for ($duration2) seconds. (Stacks once, Can only be used during night)

rex-zero-1.name: Interlaced Support
rex-zero-1.text: The Doll in the team leader position gains a ($hp_value)-point shield while all other Dolls gain a ($dam_value)% damage buff, all for ($duration) seconds.

rex-zero-1.name: Cross-Support
rex-zero-1.text: Grant the echelon leader a ($hp_value)-point shield and increase damage of all regular echelon members by ($dam_value)%, lasting ($duration) seconds.

rex-zero-1.name: Imperishable Front
rex-zero-1.text: Whenever a Dummy-Link is lost on the battlefield, generate a drone in its place to assist in the battle for ($duration) seconds. The drone inherits ($hp_value)% of the corresponding Doll's single-Dummy HP and 100% of her stats.

lusa.name: Tactical Taunting
lusa.text: [Passive]: For every 20% Max HP lost, grants self a +($hp_dam_value) HP shield. [Active]: Reduces incoming damage taken by ($hp_dam_value)% and grants self a "Taunt" effect for ($duration) seconds. [Taunt]: Enemies' basic attacks and strengthened attacks will prioritize targets with "Taunt" within attack range.

vsk-94.name: Double Alert
vsk-94.text:
When this skill is activated, transfer ($accuracy_stat_transfer)% of accuracy to damage for ($duration) seconds. The first ($number_of_attacks) attacks after this skill is activated deal two instances of damage.
[EQ Passive]: When equipped with "Police Uniform of Justice", each attack deals 3 instances of damage upon skill activation.

steyr-acr.name: Ode to the Dawn Carnival
steyr-acr.text: [Passive]: For every stat reduction effect on self, increase final damage by ($pass_duration)% (stacks additively). [Active]: Swaps to Focus mode, reducing self rate of fire by ($rof_value)%, movement speed and evasion by ($ms_eva_value)%; Increases self damage by ($dam_value)%, accuracy by ($acc_value)%, critical damage by ($crt_dam_value)% for ($pass_duration) seconds.

stg-940.name: Assault Focus
stg-940.text: Increases damage by ($dam_value)%, rate of fire by ($rof_value)% and accuracy by ($acc_value)% for ($duration) seconds.

aug-para.name: Cognitive Transformation
aug-para.text:
Clicking the skill icon toggles between modes.
[Offense Focused]: Every ($time_value) seconds, convert self evasion stat points into damage and accuracy. Every 1 points of evasion lost becomes 2 points of damage and 1 points of accuracy. This conversion stops when evasion falls below ($eva_value).
[Evasion Focused]: Every ($time_value) seconds, convert self damage and accuracy into evasion. Every 1 points of damage and 1 points of accuracy lost become 4 points of evasion. This conversion stops when damage falls below ($dam_value) points or accuracy falls below ($acc_value) points.
Stat changes are calculated after other buffs or debuffs are factored in. Converted stat points will not be lost because a buff or debuff is gone. After switching modes, priority will be given to restoring converted stat points.
[EQ Passive]: When “Exquisite Dangle” is equipped, gain 50 points of damage, evasion, and accuracy at the start of the battle, which last until the end of the battle.

general-liu.name: Shared Hatred
general-liu.text: [Passive]: At the start of battle, summon 3 reinforcement T-Dolls with 3 dummy links each to the rear of the echelon. Each reinforcement has 5 HP per dummy link and inherits the following stats from General Liu; ($dam_value)% damage, ($rof_value)% rate of fire and ($acc_value)% accuracy. The remaining stats and targeting mode are also the same as General Liu. [Active]: Activate the skill to switch between the following modes; [Rear-Focus (default)]: Reduces own rate of fire by 10% and increases own damage by 20% and targets the furthest enemy from self. [Vanguard-Focus]: Reduces own damage by 10% and increases own rate of fire by 20% and targets the nearest enemy from self.

mondragon.name: Conviction of Certain Victory
mondragon.text: [Passive]: If currently assigned as an echelons leader, permanently reduces own rate of fire by 35% while increasing allied Rifles' critical hit rate by ($crt_value)% and critical hit damage by ($crtd_value)%. [Active]: When skill is activated, allies on her tiles gain ($dam_value)% damage and ($rof_value)% rate of fire for ($duration) seconds. [EQ Passive]: When equipped with "Old Camouflage Uniform", does not reduce own rate of fire when assigned as the echelons leader.

vhs.name: Destructor Intrusion
vhs.text: [Passive]: Obtains +1 stack of "Destruct" every second. For every stack of "Destruct" currently active, increases own final damage by ($pass_value)% up to a max of 10 stacks. [Active]: Consumes all stacks of "Destruct" and obtains damage/accuracy/rate of fire equivalent to the stat of the enemies with the highest respective stat. The stat gain is capped at ($dam_value)% of self damage, ($acc_value)% of self accuracy and ($rof_value)% of self rate of fire. The effect lasts for ($duration) seconds and no stacks of "Destruct" can be gained throughout the skills duration.

pm1910.name: Spreading Bloodthirst
pm1910.text: [Passive]: During reloading state, allies on her tiles gain ($eva_value)% evasion, whereas allies not on her tiles gain ($dam_value)% damage. [Active]: Extends the current volley by +12 ammo. When using additional ammo, increases own accuracy by ($acc_value)% and extends the next reload time by 4 seconds.

gm6-lynx.name: Rapid Firing
gm6-lynx.text: Begin charging after skill cooldown ends, gaining 1 charge stack every second, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. When skill is used, shoot the current target thrice, dealing ($min_dam_value) ~ ($max_dam_value)x damage per shot based on the current number of charge stacks, taking 0.5 seconds to aim before each shot. All stacks will be consumed on skill use.

ts12.name: Rotating Magazine
ts12.text: Upon skill activation, the next 2 reloads have their reload time reduced to 0 seconds. Attacks after the first reload have ($dam_value)% increased damage. Attacks after the second reload have ($acc_value)% increased accuracy.

qsb-91.name: Sharpshooting
qsb-91.text: [Passive]: If there are enemies near self, switch to knife mode. In this mode, every attack will deal ($pass_value)x damage 4 times to the nearest target that cannot miss. [Active]: Fire 4 consecutive shots with perfect accuracy at the current target, with each hit dealing ($dam_value)x damage and ignores HP shields. Every shot requires 1 second of aiming.

ltlx-7000.name: Heterogenous Repulsion
ltlx-7000.text: [Passive]: Reduces damage dealt to self from enemies directly ahead by ($pass_amr_value)%. [Active]: Performs an attack that does not deal damage, forcibly knocking back moveable enemies within a 150-degree frontal cone of 6 unit radius ahead of self by 5 units, and remove the targets' HP shields and buff effects. Additionally, increases self armour by ($pass_amr_value)% for every target knocked-back (up to 5 stacks max) and reduce self damage by ($dam_value)% for ($duration) seconds.

m6-asw.name: Resilience of Blood and Fire
m6-asw.text: [Passive]: The first attack will consume all ammo and deal 4 hits. Whenever ammo is fully used up, switches to RF mode and change targeting mode to prioritise the furthest enemy from self. While RF mode is active, obtains the following stat changes: Reduced evasion by ($pass_eva)%, increased rate of fire and damage by ($pass_rof_dam)%, increased accuracy by ($pass_acc)%, increased armour piercing by +100 points. [Active]: Reload and switches back to SG mode. Grants self a taunt effect until SG mode ends. Reload time is fixed at 2 seconds. When reloading ends, remove stat changes from RF mode and gains a +($hp_value) HP shield for ($duration) seconds. (Slug ammo only applies to normal attacks under SG mode)

v-pm5.name: Survival First
v-pm5.text: [Passive]: Whenever movement is made, grants self +9 movement speed which gradually decays within 9 seconds. [Active]: Gains additional evasion equal to ($eva_value)x of armour value for ($duration) seconds.

hk512.name: Fiery Dimension
hk512.text: [Passive]: When reloading, reduce the remaining skill cooldown time by ($rt_buff_value)% for self and other shotguns in the same column. [Active]: Upon skill activation, increases own armour and evasion by ($rt_buff_value)% for every shotgun in the echelon for ($duration) seconds.

sub-2000.name: Griffin Command
sub-2000.text: For every allied two/three-star rarity T-Doll on the field, increase said T-Dolls' damage, rate of fire, accuracy, evasion and armour by ($stat_value1)% for ($duration) seconds. The buff increases based on the number of two/three-star T-Dolls present, up to a max of ($stat_value2)%.

ar-57.name: Complex Modification
ar-57.text: When skill is activated, grants effects based on the number of allies present on their buff tiles; If there is more than 2 allies present, increases damage by ($dam_value)% for ($duration) seconds to self and allies on their tiles. If there is 2 or less allies present, increases evasion by ($eva_value)% for ($duration) seconds to self and allies on their tiles.

svch.name: Candy Echo
svch.text: [Passive]: When changing attack targets, increases own damage by ($dam_value)% for ($duration) seconds (stacks up to 4 layers). [Active]: For ($duration) seconds, each attack from every dummy link carries an additional ($fixed_value) points of fixed damage, ignoring enemy evasion, armour and HP shields; When attacking enemies with multiple dummy links, the effect is doubled.

fx-05.name: Snake-Nest Hunting
fx-05.text: Increases own damage by ($dam_value)% for ($duration) seconds. While skill is active, for every layer of damage buffs obtained, increases own rate of fire by ($rof_value)% until the skill ends (stacks up to 8 layers).

kolibri.name: Hummingbird Resonance
kolibri.text: [Passive]: Gain +1 Hummingbird every 2 seconds. If there are no allied units in the same column at the start of battle, gain +3 Hummingbirds instantly. Can hold up to 9 Hummingbirds. For every Hummingbird possessed, self attacks inflict an additional 1x damage.

derringer.name: Covert Killer
derringer.text: [Passive]: Normal attacks fire 2 bullets, dealing 0.5x damage twice. If both bullets hit, deal additional damage equal to ($hp_value1)% of the enemy's lost HP (capped at 5x of self damage). [Active]: Increase damage dealt by each bullet to ($dam_value)x. Additional damage dealt is increased to ($hp_value2)% of the enemy's lost HP (capped at 5x of self damage). During the skill, attacks against enemies with less than 50% HP will never miss. The skill lasts for ($duration) seconds.

vp1915.name: Adaptive Suppression
vp1915.text: [Passive]: Attacks against enemies inflict an amplifying debuff that increases damage received by ($amp_value)% for ($duration) seconds, stacking up to 5 layers. After 6 seconds, the debuff inflicted from attacks is doubled. [Active]: Activate the skill to switch between the following modes; [Strafing mode (default)]: Attack 2 enemies, dealing ($dam_value)x damage each. Prioritize enemies that have not been attacked yet. [Secure mode]: Deal ($dam_value)x damage twice to the same enemy. The first hit will have perfect accuracy.

savage-99.name: Hunting Time
savage-99.text: [Passive]: At battle start, select a random target as prey. After participating in killing the prey, increase self damage by ($dam_value1)% and accuracy by +($acc_value) points. When the prey dies, select another random enemy as prey. [Active]: Immediately target the enemy with the highest HP as prey and attack them until that unit dies. While skill is active, every attack increases self damage by ($dam_value2)%, stacking up to 5 layers and lasting until the current prey dies or the skill ends. The skill lasts for ($duration) seconds.

fedorov.name: Matryorshka Tactics
fedorov.text: [Passive]: When receiving DMG/ROF/EVA/ACC/CRIT buffs (including fairy talents), reduce current cooldown by 20%. Can only be activated once every skill cooldown. [Active]: Permanently increases damage by ($dam_value)%. The 3rd activation also increases rate of fire by ($rof_value)%. The 5th activation also increases accuracy by ($acc_value)%. Can be activated up to 6 times.

ppd-40.name: Firepower Union
ppd-40.text: [Passive]: For every ally in the same column, increase own damage and accuracy by ($dam_acc_value)%, stacking up to 2 layers. [Active]: Increase all allies' damage by ($dam_value)% for ($duration) seconds.

de-lisle.name: Silent Marking
de-lisle.text: [Passive]: Whenever a dummy link deals a critical hit, add +1 layer of Marking on the target, stacking up to 15 layers. When an enemy reaches 15 layers of Marking, remove the enemy's HP shield and any evasion or armour increasing effects, and reduce its evasion and armour by ($debuff_value)% for 5 seconds. This effect can only be triggered once per target. [Active]: Increase all allies' critical hit rate by ($crt_value)%. Additionally, enemies with Marking receive +($amp_value)% more damage taken per layer of Marking. Effects last for ($duration) seconds.

sig-mcx.name: Electroshock Gear
sig-mcx.text: [Passive]: Increase own damage dealt to targets under abnormal status by ($amp_value)%. Normal attacks prioritize enemies under abnormal status. At the start of battle, gain 3 Taser charges. Gain +1 additional Taser charge every 10 seconds (can store up to 5). [Active]: Consume 1 Taser charge and deal ($dam_value)x damage to the nearest enemy with perfect accuracy. Additionally, apply the following effects to the target and enemies behind the target: stun the targets for ($duration) seconds and reduce their rate of fire and movement speed by ($debuff_value)% for 6 seconds (duration reduced by half against elite enemies).

rpk-203.name: Teddy Bear Frontline
rpk-203.text: [Passive]: Allied SG on self tiles obtain position fortification effect; When receiving damage, place a teddy bear ahead of self that taunts enemies. This effect can be triggered once every 15 seconds for every unit, and the teddy bear inherits 5% Max HP, 50% evasion, and 50% armour of that unit. Each teddy bear lasts for 5 seconds. [Active]: Activate the skill to switch between the following modes; [Continuous mode (default)]: Reduce own damage and accuracy by ($dam_acc_value)% and increase attack interval by ($aspd_value)%. No reloading is required while in this mode. [Burst mode]: Increase own critical hit rate by ($crt_value)% and critical hit damage by ($crtd_value)%, and attack the target with the highest HP. Every 4th hit will deal double damage.

tkb-408.name: Polar Night Flash
tkb-408.text: During nighttime, Increases her damage and critical hit damage by ($dam_value1)% (($dam_value2)% during day) for ($duration) seconds. Additionally, if there are 3 or more gun types on field, increase critical hit rate by ($crate_value)% (Does not apply during day battles).

sp9.name: Rho Aias
sp9.text: [Passive]: When there are 2 or more SMGs in the echelon, grants a +($hp_value) HP shield to the echelon at battle start and reduce initial skill cooldown by 15%. [Active]: Reduce the damage stat of enemies within an area of 6 units ahead by ($debuff_value), lasting for ($duration) seconds.

kh2002.name: Pelé's Mission
kh2002.text: After battle start, the Bulldog Pelé joins the fight, inheriting the following stats from KH2002; ($dam_value)% damage, 80% rate of fire, ($acc_value)% accuracy. This unit cannot be targeted, cannot crit and is unaffected by aura effects. When KH2002 retreats, Pelé also retreats. KH2002's final damage is reduced by ($debuff_value)% until the end of the battle.

apc556.name: Dance With Me
apc556.text: When there are 3 or more ARs in the echelon, increase self damage by ($dam_value1)%. When receiving damage buffs, increase the echelon leader's damage by ($dam_value2)% of the current multiplicative damage buffs on self for ($duration) seconds. This effect cannot trigger other skill effects.

fara-83.name: Time Reversal
fara-83.text: [Passive]: When there are 3 or more ARs in the echelon, increase critical hit rate of allies within 1 tile of self by ($cr_value)%. [Active]: Record the stats of the ally with the current highest DPS, and return ($record_value)% of the recorded stats to that ally after 6 seconds. This effect lasts for ($duration) seconds. Within the effect period, the target's stats will be constantly overwritten by the recorded stats. This effect cannot trigger other skill effects.

mg338.name: Get Smashed
mg338.text: Prioritize the enemy with the highest base damage. Can continue firing after running out of ammo, and only reloads when self DPS is the highest among all allies. Every attack increases self critical hit rate by ($cr_value)% for 4 seconds, stacking up to 12 layers.

cz-100.name: Interlude Division
cz-100.text: Alternates between "Advance State" and "Suppression State" aura effects.  Defaults to Advance State when skill is first activated. [Advance State]: During nighttime, increases all allies' damage by ($dam_value1)% (($dam_value2)% during daytime) for ($duration) seconds (in both day and night). [Suppression State]:  During nighttime, decreases all enemies damage by ($debuff_value1)% (($debuff_value2)% during daytime) for 8 seconds (in both day and night)

sr-2.name: Embezzlement Negotiations
sr-2.text: Marks the target with the current highest HP and prioritize attacking it for 3 seconds (prioritizes bosses if they are present). For 3 seconds, self attacks will have perfect accuracy, guaranteed critical hits and bypass HP shields. After 3 seconds, if the marked target is still on the battlefield, inflict a ($amp_cd_value)% amplification debuff on the target while applying a Taunt effect onto it which causes friendly units to target it, lasting ($duration) seconds.  If the marked target dies or vanishes, all allies' remaining skill cooldown times are reduced by ($amp_cd_value)%.

hs-50.name: Cometary Wildfire
hs-50.text: Minimum attack interval is 1 second, prioritizes armoured enemy units and does ($dam_value1)x damage to them. Rests for 5 seconds every 5 attacks. Damage to armoured units is increased by ($dam_value2)%.

ak-74m.name: Katyusha
ak-74m.text: Depending on current skill level, T-Dolls in the echelon carrying an [AK] are enhanced.

active_value: AK-74M, AK-47 (Reach SL-4 for next effect)
AK-74M, AK-47 (Reach SL-4 for next effect)
AK-74M, AK-47 (Reach SL-4 for next effect)
AK-74M, AK-47, AK-74U (Reach SL-6 for next effect)
AK-74M, AK-47, AK-74U (Reach SL-6 for next effect)
AK-74M, AK-47, AK-74U, AK-12 (Reach SL-8 for next effect)
AK-74M, AK-47, AK-74U, AK-12 (Reach SL-8 for next effect)
AK-74M, AK-47, AK-74U, AK-12, AK-15 (Reach SL-10 for last effect)
AK-74M, AK-47, AK-74U, AK-12, AK-15 (Reach SL-10 for last effect)
AK-74M, AK-47, AK-74U, AK-12, AK-15, AK-Alfa

fo-12.name: Critical Starburst
fo-12.text: At the start of battle, if there are other shotgun T-Dolls in the same column, grant perfect accuracy to self and increase knockback chance by 10%. Whenever an enemy is hit by an attack, increase "Activity" by 1 point. When Activity hits 100 points, deal fatal damage to the non-elite enemy unit with the highest damage stat. Thereafter, increase self damage by ($dam_value)%, attack interval becomes fixed at 1 second, and cease reloading until the end of the battle.

m26-mass.name: Cheese Coagulase
m26-mass.text: [Passive]: Becomes immune to damage 5 points or lower. [Active]: Creates an area 2 units ahead of self that deals damage to enemies every second equal to ($dam_value)x of the users armour. This damage has perfect accuracy, bypasses armour and can damage dummy-links. Additionally, machineguns within the rearmost column gain 90% incoming damage reduction. Both effects lasts for 10 seconds.

supernova.name: Mission Guarantee
supernova.text: When moving, increases own movement speed by +6 points. Grant buffs to allies based on self position during battle: When in the frontmost column, increases own armour by ($value1)%, while other shotguns in the same column gain a +($value2) HP shield every second up to a max of 5 stacks; When in the rearmost column, increases own damage by ($value1)%, while machineguns in the same column gain +($value3) points to their accuracy and ($value1)% increased critical hit rate.

mag-7.name: Midday Hunt
mag-7.text: [Passive]: When there are less than 3 targets, increase self critical hit damage by ($dam_value1)% and ignore enemy Armour. [Active]: Activate Hunting mode. Attack target will lock-on to and attack the nearest enemy unit, and both self and the target will have ($dam_value1)% increased damage for the duration of the skill. The remaining enemy units besides the target will have ($dam_value2)% reduced damage. The skill lasts for 5 seconds. If the target dies during Hunting mode, Hunting mode will end and self gains +100 points to her damage stat (stackable).

zip-22.name: Rebellious Doctrine
zip-22.text: If currently an echelon member, the echelon leader and all enemies have ($debuff_value)% reduced damage, accuracy, evasion and movement speed for ($duration) seconds. If currently the echelon leader or if the leader is not on the battlefield, all allies have ($dam_value)% increased damage and 90% reduced evasion for ($duration) seconds.

vigneron-m2.name: Defensive Fortification
vigneron-m2.text: Reduces the movement speed of the entire echelon to 0 and creates a protective cover at all allies' current positions after 2 seconds. Allies under protective cover will have ($eva_value)% increased evasion and becomes immune to damage equal to or below ($dam_value) points, lasting for ($duration) seconds. Movement speed returns to normal after protective cover expires.

a-545.name: Booze Formation
a-545.text: [Passive]: When currently the echelon leader or if the leader is not on the battlefield, all allied assault rifles gain ($cdam_value)% critical hit damage. [Active]: Activate Liquor mode for ($duration) seconds, increasing own damage by ($dam_value)% and raising critical hit rate to 100%. Prioritize attacking elite enemies. When the skill ends, permanently reduces own accuracy and evasion by 40% for the remainder of the current battle (stacks up to 2 layers).

rhino.name: Daredevil Roulette
rhino.text: [Passive]: Every 6th attack will deal 0.1x/ 0.5x/ 1x/ ($4th_chamber)x/ ($5th_chamber)x/ ($6th_chamber)x damage. The first shot of each round is random, and the following shots will cycle in order. If the first shot has a multiplier of 1x or higher, increases own accuracy and critical hit damage by ($acc_cdam_value)%, otherwise decreases own movement speed and evasion by ($debuff_value)% for 20 seconds. [Active]: Increases own rate of fire by ($rof_value)% for ($duration) seconds.

ppq.name: Bone-Scraping Silver Dust
ppq.text: [Passive]: After every 5 seconds, apply the following debuffs to the enemy units with the highest current DMG/ROF/EVA/ACC respectively: Damage -($dam_rof1)%, Rate of fire -($dam_rof1)%, Evasion -($eva_acc1)%, Accuracy -($eva_acc1)%, lasting for 3 seconds. [Active]: Enemy units that currently carry a DMG/ROF/EVA/ACC debuff have the corresponding stats reduced by ($dam_rof2)%/($dam_rof2)%/($eva_acc2)%/($eva_acc2)% for ($duration) seconds. Debuffs on different stats take effect at the same time.

tf-q.name: Wind-Born Magic Bullet
tf-q.text: Increases damage by ($dam_value)% and grants self perfect accuracy against unarmoured enemy units, lasting for ($duration) seconds. If there are more than 5 groups of enemies on the battlefield, increases movement speed and evasion of the entire echelon by +5 points and ($eva_value)% respectively for ($duration) seconds.

qbz-191.name: Culprit Elimination
qbz-191.text: [Passive]: When attacking the same enemy unit, every second attack deals an additional instance of ($dam_value)x damage in a radius of 1.5 units. This attack has perfect accuracy, but cannot do critical damage, does not scale with Dummy-Links, and does not bypass armour. [Active]: Attacks of each Dummy are calculated separately. Attacks can be directed at different enemy units, prioritizing bosses and high-threat units, lasting for ($duration) seconds. When the skill is activated, each Dummy's first attack silences enemies in a radius of 1.5 units for 4 seconds (effective only against high-threat enemies).

ls26.name: Snowfield Refraction
ls26.text: [Passive]: While reloading, reduce enemy units' rate of fire and accuracy by ($debuff_value)%. [Active]: Increases ammo capacity of self and MG T-Dolls on the same column by +($clip_value). Also grants a special buff on allies on her buff tiles that renders all damage intake to a fixed value of 5 for ($duration) seconds and extends the duration of their next reload by 2 seconds.

mpl.name: Silver Moon Wavefield
mpl.text: [Passive]: Every second, grant all units within 1 tile +1 stack of the Lightscatter effect. Units with Lightscatter gain a +($hp_value1) point HP shield, stacking up to 5 times. [Active]: Grants a more powerful Lightscatter effect, increasing the shield value to +($hp_value2) points. Units with Lightscatter will take ($amp_value)% increased damage for ($duration) seconds. If this unit possesses the Flareup effect, then when granting the Lightscatter effect, enemy units with HP shields take an additional ($dam_value) points of damage.

mpk.name: Blazing Lightfield
mpk.text: [Passive]: Every second, grant all units within 1 tile +1 stack of the Flareup effect. Units with Flareup lose 0.5% of their max HP. [Active]: Grant a more powerful Flareup effect, HP loss increases to ($hp_value)% of max HP. Units with Flareup gain ($dam_value)% increased damage for ($duration) seconds. If this unit possesses the Lightscatter effect, granting Flareup will also reduce enemy movement speed and rate of fire by ($debuff_value)%.

scr.name: Compound Propellant
scr.text: Defaults to Light Rifle mode. When skill is activated, switches over to Battle Rifle  mode for auto-attacks. Every auto-attack expends -1 point of Battle Rifle ammo. When all Battle Rifle ammo is depleted, switches back to Light Rifle mode. When in Light Rifle mode, each shot adds +1 Battle Rifle Ammo. When gaining a buff that increases DMG, ROF, EVA, ACC, MS, Crit Rate or Crit DMG, grants self +5 Battle Rifle Ammo. Every skill use or buff gain can only add ammo once. When skill is not on cooldown, grants self +1 Battle Rifle Ammo per second and record all other Battle Rifle Ammo gains. This amount is added up and when the skill duration ends, switching back to Light Rifle mode will directly grant the appropriate amount of Battle Rifle ammo. When using Battle Rifle Ammo, all auto-attacks will have perfect accuracy and deal ($dam_value)% increased damage and they do not add any Battle Rifle Ammo.

spas-15.name: Musical Resonance
spas-15.text: At the start of each battle: gains +1 "Note" for each MG-Doll, +2 for each SG-Doll and +3 if SPAS-12 is present. Each "Note" grants the user +($dam_red)% incoming damage reduction and grants only one of the following effects;

mk3a1.name: B-52 Improved Drone
mk3a1.text: [Passive]: At the start of the battle: if own rate of fire exceeds 40 points, gain own tile buff effects. The active skill can only be used 3 times. [Active]: Builds a B-52 Improved Drone to assist in the battle. The Drones take 100% increased damage, cannot receive class-based buffs, and disappear if MK3A1 leaves battle.

uts-15.name: Blue Star☆Solar
uts-15.text: [Passive]: Grant all allies on the 8 adjacent tiles surrounding self +($amr_val) points of armor. Additionally, allies in this area will receive +($acc_val) points of accuracy every second, up to a max of ($acc_max) points. [Active]: Grant self and other dolls in the same column +($dam_red)% incoming damage reduction for ($duration) seconds. All allies with max accuracy stacks gain an additional +2 ammo.

m327.name: DD-Black Claw Attack
m327.text: [Special Bullets]: Deal ($damage)% damage and reduce the targets evasion by ($eva_red)% for ($duration) seconds, up to 3 stacks. [Passive]: When receiving a buff, gain +3 Special Bullets. When an ally whose on their buff tiles receives a buff, gain +1 Special Bullet. Can hold 99 Special Bullets. [Active]: On skill activation, all allies will retarget and prioritise their attacks to the echelon leader's current target for 3 seconds. Use Special Bullets for normal attacks until no Special Bullets remain.

p290.name: Dizzying Nightmare
p290.text: [Passive]: When more than 8 enemy groups are within the echelon's attack range, stun the 4 highest threat enemies for ($stun) seconds. Can only activate once per battle. [Active]: Reduces the damage of all enemies by ($damage_value)%. During nighttime, additionally increases the night vision of all allies by +($nv_value)%. Skill lasts for ($duration) seconds.

saiga-308.name: Order 226
saiga-308.text: [Passive]: Every 2 attacks grants +1 Command Point, up to 20 max. [Active]: Increase self rate of fire by ($rof_self)%, then consume current stack of Command Points to increase the rate of fire and critical hit damage of allies on adjacent tiles by 1% for every Command Point, lasting for ($duration) seconds.

ar-18.name: Commanding Guidance
ar-18.text: [Passive]: Prioritise attacking enemies with missing links, dealing additional damage based on the number of missing links, up to ($dam_self)% additional damage. [Active]: Assault rifles and Submachine guns on their tiles gain ($buff)% damage and ($buff)% accuracy and will retarget and prioritise AR-18's current target for ($duration) seconds.

cmr-30.name: Smashing Detonation
cmr-30.text: Each link launches a Tennis Ball at the current target, dealing ($dam_value)x link-based damage to the target and all enemies in its line of fire them. Enemies damaged by this skill receive a mark. After this skill, if self DPS is the highest damage among all allies, all marked enemies receive damage equal to ($percent_dam)% of their max HP and clear the mark.

m240l.name: Heart of Paladin
m240l.text: [Passive]: At the start of battle, if there are more allies present than enemies, gain +50 points of Chivalry. Each attack grants +1 point of Chivalry. Each point of Chivalry grants +1 damage and armor penetration. Maximum of 100 points of Chivalry.

colt-walker.name: Social Engineering
colt-walker.text: During this battle, all friendly units' rate of fire is decreased by 30% and cannot gain rate of fire buffs, while enemies cannot benefit from damage-increasing buffs. When other friendly units use their active skill (other than mode changes) or when they finish reloading, the entire team gains a +($shield) point HP shield and ($dam_value)% increased damage. This effect lasts ($duration) seconds and stacks up to 10 times.

erma.name: Secret Garden
erma.text: [Passive]: Reduces Initial skill cooldown by 25% for every other SMG present apart from self. [Active]: After activation, the active skills of all other ally Dolls on the field instantly finish cooling down and increase all units' damage and evasion by ($buff_value)% for ($duration) seconds.

scar-h.name: Shining Maria
scar-h.text: [Passive]: After battle begins, odd-numbered tiles on the map become [Luna Maria] tiles. Friendly units standing on Luna Maria tiles gain +1 point of [Mare Potentia] every second they are on that tile, up to a maximum of 100 points. Allies standing on Luna Maria tiles will not take odd-numbered amounts of damage below 30 points. Friendly units who perform normal attacks while standing on a Luna Maria tile trigger the [Combo Hit] effect, dealing an additional instance of ($dam_value)% damage. [Active]: Consumes all points of Mare Potentia to grant allies +1 point of rate of fire per point of Mare Potentia expended, lasting for ($duration) seconds.

scar-l.name: Sacred Corona
scar-l.text: [Passive]: After battle begins, even-numbered tiles on the map become [Sancta Terra] tiles. Friendly units standing on Sancta Terra tiles grants self +1 point of [Sancta Potentia] every second they are on that tile, up to a maximum of 100 points. Allies standing on Sancta Terra tiles will not take even-numbered amounts of damage below 30 points. Friendly units who perform normal attacks while standing on Sancta Terra tiles trigger the [Afterburn] effect, dealing an additional flat 100 points of fixed damage. [Active]: Consumes all points of Sancta Potentia to grant self +($dam_value) points of damage per point of Sancta Potentia expended, lasting for ($duration) seconds.

apc9k.name: Revolving Tango
apc9k.text: When the team leader is not present, increase self evasion by ($eva_value)% for ($duration) seconds. When the team leader is present, increase the leader's rate of fire by ($rof_value)% for ($duration) seconds. While the skill is active, every instance of damage dealt by the leader's normal attacks on enemy units increases the users evasion by +4 points, lasting ($duration) seconds and capping at 200 points. When accumulated evasion reaches the 200-point cap, allies on buff tiles deal ($amp_value)% more damage for 3 seconds. This damage buff can only be triggered once per skill use.

m110.name: Inner-Outer Waltz
m110.text: [Passive]: When rate of fire reaches 100 points, normal attacks deal 2 instances of 60% damage. When rate of fire reaches 150 points, normal attacks deal 3 instances of 45% damage. Each additional instance of damage can benefit from effects that enhance normal attacks. [Active]: Increases own rate of fire by ($rof_value)% for ($duration) seconds.

msbs.name: Reverse Radiation
msbs.text: [Passive]: When inflicted with an DMG/ROF/EVA/ACC debuff, reduce the corresponding stat of all enemy units by ($dam_rof)%/($dam_rof)%/($eva_acc)%/($eva_acc)% respectively for 3 seconds. After 12 attacks, grant self a debuff that reduces a random stat by 1% for 3 seconds. [Active]: Increase damage taken by all enemy units — Enemy units take an additional +($dam_value) points of damage for every kind of debuff they currently have, lasting ($duration) seconds.

vp9.name: Angel's Heart
vp9.text: [Passive]: Trigger a Charity Drive every 2 seconds after the start of battle. Each group of enemies within range will donate a stack of Funds, and if there are no enemies within range, generate a stack of Funds from self. Stacks up to 20 times.

jatimatic.name: Flower Dream
jatimatic.text: [Passive]: Damage taken that is below the Max Energy value is reduced by ($value1)%. Maximum amount of Energy is 100 points.

vrb.name: Overclock Impact
vrb.text: The next 5 attacks will do ($dmg_value)x damage, and can score critical hits. When there are more than 5 allies on the field at skill activation, the number of attacks increases by +1 for every additional allied unit present.

lamg.name: AB Plane Flip
lamg.text: [Passive]: This unit can use AR equipment.

tps.name: Super Popular Leaderboard
tps.text: [Passive]: When currently the echelon leader, start battle with +30 points of Popularity. When not an echelon leader, MGs and SGs on buff tiles gain +100 points of armour-piercing and +30 points of accuracy. When an enemy unit loses a Dummy-Link, gain +1 point of Popularity, and when an allied unit loses a Dummy-Link, gain +10 points of Popularity. When Popularity reaches the following values, apply the appropriate effects;</br>

qbu-191.name: Gold-Plated Bronze Tiger Military Seal
qbu-191.text: [Passive] Gain 1/3/5 coins for every regular/elite/Boss unit killed by the echelon.

boys-at-rifle.name: BVR Annihilation
boys-at-rifle.text: Reduces own rate of fire by 30% for ($duration1) seconds and changes attacks to piercing shots. While the skill is active, shots have varied effects based on the types of enemies along the shots trajectory;

hk433.name: Enduring Glory
hk433.text: [Passive]: The first time an Elite enemy unit's HP drops below 70% from an attack, launch a small grenade at them, dealing ($dam_value1)x damage in a radius of 1.5 units. This damage scales with the targets Dummy-links. Additional grenades will be launched from the users Dummy-links if multiple units drop below the HP threshold.

type-82.name: Sunlit Wanderer
type-82.text:
Maximum 6 charges/Starts with 1 charges
Activation interval 2 seconds
[Passive]: Gain 1 charges every 4 seconds. If there are enemy units within a distance of 5 ahead of self, gain 1 additional charges.
[Active]: Consume 1 charges and throw a grenade, dealing ($grenade_damage)% damage that scales with Dummy-Links to enemy units within a radius of 2.5.,Gain an ability upgrade with every 2 grenades thrown, up to a maximum of 3 upgrades.
[Ability Upgrade I]: grenade AoE is enlarged to 4;
[Ability Upgrade II]: damage against enemies with no Dummy-Links increases by ($single_damage)%.
[Ability Upgrade III]: gain a shield with ($shield)% of max. HP for every group of enemies blasted by her grenades, stacking up to 6 times.

owen.name: Impression Negatives
owen.text: [Passive]: When 3 or more SMGs are assigned to the echelon, increases damage of allies in the same column as the user by ($dam_value)%.

beowulf.name: Epic of the Hunter
beowulf.text: [Passive]: At the start of the battle, mark enemy units in this order while prioritizing unmarked units: the enemy with the highest threat level is marked as the Dragon, the enemy with the highest damage the Kraken, and the enemy with the highest HP the Giant. Beowulf deals ($dmg_value1)% increased damage to marked enemies. Effects of multiple markers are stackable. Defeated marked enemies grant the user the following additional effects based on the targets mark;

cm901.name: Battlefield Master Thief
cm901.text: Steal 3 different kinds of buffs from 1 buffed non-Boss enemy units for ($duration1) seconds, prioritizing HP shields, damage and rate of fire buffs. If no buffs can be stolen, increases own damage by ($dam_value)% for ($duration2) seconds.

fm24.name: Rift Dissection
fm24.text: Prioritize attacking the closest enemy unit. Each attack deals additional guaranteed non-critical damage that equals ($dam_value)% of Investigation Points. Each attack on the same target increases Investigation Points by +20, and switching to a different target reduces them by 10%. Investigation Points increase by +($inv_value) when reloading. Investigation Points are capped at 1000.

mg15.name: Twilight Omen
mg15.text: Fire at the enemy unit with the highest current HP, while also summoning air support that deals 6 hits of ($dam_value)% damage every second, lasting ($duration) seconds. While the skill is in effect, MG15 will not reload when attacking her current target until she switches to a new target.

stevens-m520.name: Death Knell
stevens-m520.text: At the start of the battle, if there are no other Dolls on tiles adjacent to self, reload time is fixed at 2 seconds for the rest of the battle. Each attack will consume all ammo, dealing 5x damage. If more than 10 rounds are consumed, also reduce the target's damage by ($dam_value)% for 1 second. After each reload, gain a shield with HP that equals ($hp_value)x her ammo capacity, lasting ($duration) seconds.

stevens-m620.name: Rampart Front
stevens-m620.text: [Passive]: At the start of the battle, construct 3 barricades, then generate 1 barricade on a random empty buff tile every time she reloads. Friendly units standing on barricaded tiles take 25% less damage and gain a 50% increase in movement speed. When Stevens M620 herself is on a barricade tile, the buff effects are doubled.

p2000.name: Key to Victory
p2000.text: [Active]: Activate to switch between one of two passive effects;

colt-m1851n.name: Serenity Incense
colt-m1851n.text:
[Passive]: For the duration of this battle, all allied units are constantly afflicted with a debuff that reduces their accuracy by 80% and cannot receive any accuracy buffs, while enemy units cannot receive any damage buffs.
[Active]: Reduce all enemy units' accuracy by ($accuracy)% and inflict ($vulnerability)% vulnerability on them, lasting 3 seconds.

p50.name: Heradon's Protection
p50.text:
[Passive]: Other echelon members gain a ($value1)-point shield and ($value2)% evasion increase when they first take damage, lasting until the end of the battle. The buff effects are doubled on P90.
[Active]: Reduce all enemy units' damage by ($value3)% for ($value4) seconds and dispel all shields on non-Boss enemy units once.

martini-henry.name: Dazzling Six-Fold Strike
martini-henry.text:
[Passive]: Every normal attack deals 6 instances of 20% damage, with each instance applying a normal attack's effect. After attacking for total of 300 times(including her Dummy-Links' attacks), reduce all enemy units' evasion by 100% and inflict 10% vulnerability on them, lasting 8 seconds.
[Active]: Increase self damage by ($dmg_value) and evasion of allies on buff tiles by ($eva_value), lasting ($lasts_for) seconds.

sig-cross.name: Hunting Mark
sig-cross.text:
[Passive]: Receive one stack of Hunting Mark for every critical hit, capped at 25 stacks. Every time this unit participates in the successful killing of a target, convert all accumulated stacks of Hunting Mark into buffs, with each stack providing 2% damage and rate of fire increase for 10 seconds.
[Active]: Immediately convert Hunting Marks and mark the highest HP enemy, directing the entire echelon to focus fire at it for ($duration) seconds. If the target is killed during the active skill, the entire echelon receives the effect of 5 converted Hunting Marks. (Not affected by the cap of 25 Hunting Marks.)

mk-18.name: Crisis Management
mk-18.text:
[Passive]: Every time a dummy link is lost, increase damage by 25% and gain 25% damage reduction for 99 seconds.
[Active]: Increase damage and critical rate of the entire echelon by ($buff)% for ($duration) seconds. For every enemy within a range of 6 units, additionally increase self damage and critical rate by 5% with a cap of 5 stacks, this effect lasting ($duration) seconds.

sig-m400.name: Second-Place Bonus
sig-m400.text: Make a check after every 3 seconds; if self's damage dealt is not the top among the ARs in the echelon, increase damage, accuracy and critical rate by ($buff)% for 100 seconds.

xm556.name: Lock-On Shield
xm556.text:
[Passive]: This unit gains a shield when reloading that provides ($damage_reduction)% damage reduction to self and gives all allies in the column in front a 100 HP shield, lasting for ($shield_duration) seconds.
[Active]: Turn on Lock-On mode for ($lock_on_duration) seconds, which enables this unit to attack without consuming ammo or reloading. This unit will prioritize the highest HP enemy, with each attack or critical hit increasing self damage by ($damage_increase). (Changing the target or ending Lock-On mode clears this buff.)

hti.name: Coordinates Locked
hti.text:
Switch between attack modes by clicking the skill in battle. Initial default is Upright Shooting Mode.
[Upright Shooting Mode]: Attack the furthest enemy unit, dealing ($upright_damage)% damage with the first attack on each target and reducing their move speed and evasion by ($buff_and_debuff)% for 3 seconds. When switching to this mode, increase damage and accuracy by ($buff_and_debuff)% until switching to another mode.
[Hip Shooting Mode]: Attack the nearest enemy unit, dealing two instances of ($hip_damage)% damage. The lower the target's HP, the higher the damage (increase damage by 8% for every 10% target's HP lost, with damage increase capping at 30%). When switching to this mode, accuracy is reduced by 50% until switching to another mode.
[Prone Shooting Mode]: Attack an enemy elite unit, and increase self damage and accuracy by ($prone_buff)% for every successive attack on the same target to a maximum of 10 stacks. The number of stacks is halved when switching to another target and drops to zero when switching to another mode. When switching to this mode, increase accuracy by 50% until switching to another mode.

maxim-9.name: Cursed Puppet
maxim-9.text: Passive: If this unit enters battle with a silencer equipped, when receiving buffs from an evasion-buffing skill during this battle (includes fairies), additionally increase this unit's evasion by 20% for 5 seconds, to a maximum of 3 stacks (this effect does not trigger itself).

hecate-ii.name: Acherontia Prelude
hecate-ii.text: The more HP lost by this unit, the more damage dealt, to a maximum of 300%. When enemy units lose dummy-links, gain 1 point(s) of Geist and when ally units lose dummy-links, gain 10 points of Geist.

mini-14.name: Glorious Penetrator
mini-14.text: [Passive]: Damage dealt to lightly-armored enemies is increased by ($damage_increase_vs_lightly_armored_targets)% and damage dealt to heavily-armored enemies is reduced by 20%. (Enemies with armor below 200 points are considered lightly-armored, otherwise they are considered heavily-armored)

ia2.name: Spicy Samba
ia2.text: [Passive]: Each attack deals additional damage equal to ($value1)% of this unit's current HP and shield value damage multiplier.

xcr.name: Stylish Rhythm
xcr.text: Increase this unit's damage by ($damage_increase)% for ($duration) seconds and cleanse all stat debuffs from all ally Dolls.

unica-6.name: Righteous Assembly
unica-6.text: After the start of battle, receive a stream of 20 reinforcement Dolls who will advance in front of the echelon and attack. Reinforcement Dolls have ($hp) points of HP, cannot inflict critical hits and are not affected by status effects. All other stats and attack modes are the same as Unica's at the start of the battle.

m-p9.name: Case Deduction
m-p9.text:
[Passive]: At the start of battle, scan all enemies. If they are classified as High-Threat Targets, skill cooldowns are reduced by 40% for the duration of the battle and this skill applies an additional 20 points of shield.
[Active]: All ally units' rate of fire is increased by ($rof_increase) points and their move speed is increased by 5 points for ($duration) seconds.

wz-63.name: Windward Navigation
wz-63.text: During this battle, all ally units suffer a 50% evasion decrease and gain ($damage_reduction)% damage reduction.

ssg-m1.name: Teatime
ssg-m1.text:
[Passive]: At the start of battle, gain 200 points of armor for 20 seconds. This buff is lost after being hit 100 times.
[Active]: Skill begins charging after cooldown ends, adding 1 charge per second, to a maximum of 30 charges. Clicking the skill button initiates aiming for 1.5 seconds, then expend all charges to make an attack on the furthest target which does ($base_damage_multiplier)x to ($maximum_damage_multiplier)x damage. If the target is a boss, this skill instead deals ($base_damage_multiplier_against_bosses)x to ($maximum_damage_multiplier_against_bosses)x damage.

ef88.name: Bullet of the End
ef88.text:
[Passive]: When this unit has a stat debuff, attacks are guaranteed to hit. If this unit suffers a rate of fire stat debuff, damage is increased in proportion to the amount of rate of fire reduction, to a maximum increase of 1000%.
[Active]: Remove all allied Dolls' damage reduction and vulnerability effects, then fire a grenade whose damage scales with the number of Dummy-Links which deals ($grenade_multiplier)x damage to all enemies within a 2.5 unit radius.

chiappa-triple-crown.name: Laceration Log
chiappa-triple-crown.text: [Passive]: Attacks apply the Laceration effect (moving enemies take 50 points of damage per second, which scales with Dummy-Links) for ($duration) seconds. If only SG Dolls are present during this battle, this unit's damage increases by ($damage_increase) points until the end of the battle. This effect cannot be removed.

93r.name: Triphasic Fire Control
93r.text:
[Passive]: If there are 3/4/5 HG Dolls present at the start of the battle, increase this unit's damage by 100/150/200 points until the end of the battle.
[Active]: This unit's rate of fire is reduced by ($rof_reduction)% and each attack becomes 3 instances of ($damage_multiplier)% damage to all units within a 4 unit radius, can inflict critical hits and scales with Dummy-Links for ($duration) seconds.

rex-alpha.name: Affinity Excitation
rex-alpha.text: Increase the team leader Doll's rate of fire by ($rof_increase)% and increase the damage of ally reinforcement units by ($damage_increase)% for ($duration) seconds.

hi-point-c9.name: Penetrating Rhythm
hi-point-c9.text:
[Passive]: When ally units penetrate another unit's armor, they deal an additional 100 points of damage.
[Active]: Increase all ally units' damage by ($damage_increase)% and their AP by ($ap_increase)% for ($duration) seconds.

mx4-storm.name: Sidestep Riposte
mx4-storm.text:
[Passive]: Each time this unit dodges an enemy attack, this unit's damage is increased by 10 points, stacking up to 100 times.
[Active]: Increase this unit's evasion by ($eva_increase)% and accuracy by ($acc_increase)% for ($duration) seconds.

lr-300.name: Scorching Overload
lr-300.text: At the start of battle, increase this unit's damage by ($damage_increase)% and AP by ($ap_increase) points for ($duration) seconds. Once this buff ends, this unit cannot gain it again and its rate of fire and accuracy are reduced by ($rof_and_acc_reduction)% until the end of the battle.

m887.name: Absolute Counterattack
m887.text: [Passive]: When attacked, there is a 10% chance to gain 1 points of armor, maximum of 300 points. Every 100 times this unit is attacked, it deals ($armor_multiplier)x the amount of this unit's current armor to all enemy units.

type-53.name: Signal Broadcast
type-53.text:
Each attack has a 5% chance to summon a Type 53 dummy-link, part of this unit's stats are independently determined, HP is ($flat_hp_rof_value) points, Damage is ($flat_attack_value) points, RoF is ($flat_hp_rof_value) points and it prioritizes attacking the nearest enemy units, all other stats are the same as Type 53.
Reinforcement units attack units with the Signal Broadcast effect. Remains on the field for 5 seconds and can gain damage and attack speed buffs.

noel.name: Zero-Gun: Fenrir
noel.text: Dash towards the enemy and inflict ($damage_value)x Noel's damage for 8 hits within a small area.

elphelt.name: Genoverse
elphelt.text: Inflicts ($damage_value)x damage and locks on to the target before launching a missile that deals ($damage2_value)x damage to enemies within 1.5 unit radius.

kiana.name: Asgard's Wrath
kiana.text: Generates a bolt of lightning that deals critical damage to enemies within a radius of 1.5 units. Enemies hit will be stunned for ($time_value) seconds and will take ($bebuff_value)% increased damage. (Does not affect boss units)

raiden-mei.name: Electromagnetic Shot
raiden-mei.text: Aims for 1.5 seconds and shoots the furthest target, dealing ($damage)x damage and stunning them for ($duration) seconds. (Stun effect does not work on boss units)

bronya.name: Catalytic Black Hole
bronya.text: Throws out a grenade that produces a black hole after an explosion. The black hole lasts for ($duration) seconds and attracts enemies within a radius of 2.5 units. Enemies within 1.5 units from the center of the black hole will suffer ($damage)% damage every second. This skill can only be used once per turn.

theresa.name: Divine Punishment
theresa.text: Increases damage done to enemies by ($damage)% within a radius of ($tile) units around self for ($duration) seconds, every attack has ($rootchance)% chance to immobilise target for ($rootduration) seconds. (Does not effect boss units)

murata-himeko.name: Dread of Night
murata-himeko.text: For ($duration) seconds, charm (decrease damage by ($debuff)%) and fear (decrease movement speed by ($debuff)%) the nearest 3 enemies. At the same time, increases damage against feared enemies by ($damage)%.

seele.name: Quantum Recall
seele.text: The last shot in her clip will deal ($damage)% increased damage and cause her to reload instantly.

clear.name: "Make It Better"
clear.text: Stops attacking to put on 5 performances. Each performance increases a random allies' damage and accuracy by ($b_value)%(($bu_value)% if "Glory Light" is equipped). Max 1 stack. Stacks last 3 seconds.

fail.name: "Sin Prisa"
fail.text: Stops attacking to put on 5 performances. Each performance decreases 3 random enemies' rate of fire and accuracy by ($deb_value)%(($debu_value)% if "Black Cat" is equipped). Max 2 stacks. Each stack lasts 3 seconds.

jill.name: Mixing Time
jill.text: [Passive]: For every point in Jill's base damage stat, Jill will receive 1% reduction to her skill's base cooldown up to a max of 30% base cooldown reduction (Unaffected by any damage modifiers). [Active]: After mixing in her cocktail shaker for 3 seconds, Jill will serve one of the following possible drinks to her echelon based on her current equipment loadout; ■ is Adelhyde. ■ is Flanergide. ■ is Karmotrine. ■ is Bronson Ext. ■ is Pwd Delta. ❈ is none specified.

sei.name: White Knight's Shield
sei.text: [Favorite Drink - Moonblast]: Shield's HP scaling is doubled. [Active]: Grants a shield with ($hp_value) HP to all allied SG's, SMG's and HG's. The lower the HP of the ally, the higher the HP of the shield, ranging from 0.8x to 1.8x of the base value. Lasts for ($duration) seconds. [Passive]: When Stella is present, Sei's attacks will be counted towards Stella's passive.

dorothy.name: Secret Modification
dorothy.text: [Favorite Drink - Piano Women]: Reduce the negative effects of her skill by 50%. [Passive]: Dorothy will use Nano-camouflage by default if she is in the middle row, otherwise she will use MIRD113. [Active]: Toggles between one of two skill effects; [MIRD113: Increases damage by ($dam_eva_value)% but reduces the accuracy of allies in the same column by ($acc_eva_pen)% and increases their evasion by ($eva_acc_up)%.], [Nano-camouflage: Increases evasion by ($dam_eva_value)% but reduces the evasion of allies in the same column by ($acc_eva_pen)% and increases their accuracy by ($eva_acc_up)%.]

stella.name: Puppet Mask
stella.text: [Favorite Drink - Bleeding Jane]: Puppets only require ($shot1_value) attacks to activate her passive. [Active]: Increases damage by ($dam_value)% for ($duration) seconds. [Passive 1]: When her puppets attack over ($shot2_value) times, their next round of attacks does +50% critical damage. [Passive 2]: When Sei is present, provide 10% reduction to her skill's base cooldown (Does not affect her initial cooldown).

alma.name: Love & Dreams
alma.text: [Favorite Drink - Brantini]: Increase the duration of the drones by 1 second. [Active]: Summons 2 additional drones to attack alongside her. The additional drones will deal ($dam_value)% damage each and lasts for ($duration) seconds.

dana.name: Red Geyser
dana.text: [Favorite Drink - Big Beer] - Gains a 0.5 HP shield for every 1 point of armor Dana has. [Passive]: Fires an exploding rocket fist. Can only attack 1 enemy, dealing ($pass_dam)x damage and has ($kb_chance)% chance of knockback (Does not stack with Slugs). [Active]: Jumps up and smashes the ground, causing a large explosion dealing ($dam_value)x damage and knockback to enemies within a radius of 2 units. Increases the damage of the skill by 1% for every 1 point of armor Dana has.

henrietta.name: Full Moon Protector
henrietta.text: [Passive]: Grants self a +10 HP shield at the start of battle, lasting for 8 seconds. If currently shielded, obtains +1 "Damage Mark" stack every 2 seconds up to a max of 3 stacks. For each "Damage mark" stack, increases self damage by ($dam_value)% for ($duration) seconds. If not shielded, obtains +1 "Evasion Mark" stack every 2 seconds up to a max of 3 stacks. For each "Evasion Mark" stack, increases self evasion by ($eva_rof_value)% for ($duration) seconds. [Active]: Grants self a +10 HP shield for 8 seconds. For every stack of "Damage Mark", increases self rate of fire by ($eva_rof_value)%; For every stack of "Evasion Mark", grants self an additional +($hp_value) HP shield. Effects last for ($duration) seconds.

rico.name: Tower of Tisiphone
rico.text: [Passive]: Obtains +1 Tarot Card every 3 attacks up to a max of 3 Tarot Cards. Each Tarot Card held increases own damage by ($pass_value)% for ($duration) seconds. [Active]: Consumes all held Tarot Cards and deals ($dam_value1)x damage to the furthest target. This shot has perfect accuracy and can do critical damage. Additionally, deal an additional hit to enemies within a radius of 1 unit around the target. The damage of the additional hit is equal to ($dam_value2)x the number of Tarot Cards consumed up to a max of ($dam_value3)x damage.

triela.name: Puppet Trick
triela.text: [Passive]: When there is an enemy unit within 2 units distance of herself, switches to using a bayonet to deal 2x damage to the nearest target. In this state, ammo is not consumed and rate of fire increases by ($rof_value)% (does not work with Slug ammo). If there are no enemy units within 2 units distance of herself, increases max hit targets by +1. [Active]: Increases damage by ($dam_value)% and movement speed by +($ms_value) points for ($duration) seconds.

claes.name: Thinker's Key
claes.text: [Passive]: While in Charging Mode, this unit cannot perform normal attacks. For every 2 seconds after a battle has begun, obtains +1 Charge up to a max of 5 Charges. For each held Charge, increases self damage by ($dam_value)%. [Active]: Enters attack mode. After ending attack mode and reloading, removes all damage increase from Charging mode and re-enters Charging Mode.

angelica.name: Extreme Shooting
angelica.text: [Passive]: Increases self damage by 12% at battle start. This buff gradually decays by 4% every 2 seconds, and is completely removed after 6 seconds. The buff will refresh itself every 10 seconds. [Active]: Reduces own accuracy by -($debuff_value)% and increases rate of fire to a fixed 150 for ($duration) seconds.

agent-vector.name: Mobile Cover
agent-vector.text: Deploys a mobile cover ahead of self lasting for ($duration) seconds. The mobile cover will inherit ($hp_value)% of the user's Max HP and gains a taunt effect on deployment.

agent-416.name: Sticky Bombs
agent-416.text: Every ($time_value) seconds, automatically place a sticky grenade on the enemy with the highest HP, up to a maximum of 3 grenades per enemy unit. When skill is activated, detonate all sticky grenades on the field, each dealing ($dam_value)x damage that cannot miss within an area of 1.5 units.

jashin-chan.name: Jashin Kick
jashin-chan.text: [Passive]: Jashin uses kicks as normal attacks, dealing dummy-linked damage in an area of 1 unit to the closest enemy. Kicks are affected by evasion and armour. Jashin gains HP shield equal to 10% of lost HP every 10 seconds. [Active]: Jashin Flying Kick! Jashin deals a powerful kick to the enemy with the highest HP, gaining 1.5 seconds of invincibility during the skill. The kick deals ($dam_value1)x damage to enemies within an area of 1.5 units, and at least ($dam_value2)x damage to enemies within an area of 4 units. The more enemies there are in the center, the higher the damage dealt, up to ($dam_value3)x damage.

pekora.name: Angel's Contract
pekora.text: [Passive]: Pekora does not attack in default state. After receiving 5 layers of buffs, Pekora regains her angel's halo and can attack. Deals 1x damage that ignores armour and HP shields to the enemy with the lowest HP percentage, plus additional damage equal to ($hp_value)% of the target's lost HP (cannot exceed 100% of the users damage), with a ($proc_chance)% chance of removing all of the target's buffs. [Active]: Grants HP shield equal to 5% of self Max HP to all allies for 5 seconds.

medusa.name: Gorgon's Eye
medusa.text: Randomly attack enemies and apply a mark to them. The mark reduces evasion and accuracy by ($buff_value)%, lasts for ($duration) seconds and stacks up to 5 layers. Activate skill to petrify (stun) marked enemies, amplifying their damage taken by ($buff_value)%. Each layer of mark increases petrification duration by 1 second. Every unit can only be petrified once.

yurine.name: Endless Punishment
yurine.text: [Active]: Cast magic on the enemy with the highest HP, dealing ($dam_value1)x damage to enemies within an area of 2.5 units and imprisoning them for ($duration1) seconds. [Passive]: After reloading, randomly gain 1 torture device to strengthen self. [Trident]: Immediately grant +($ammo_value) ammo to all allies and increase damage by ($buff_value)% for 8 seconds. [Iron Maiden]: Attacks reduce the target's rate of fire and movement speed by ($buff_value)% for ($duration2) seconds. After stacking to 5 layers, stuns for ($duration3) seconds and deals ($dam_value2)x damage. [Chainsaw]: Every attack deals an additional ($dam_value3)x damage that cannot miss and ignores armor and HP shield.

minos.name: Demon's Punch
minos.text: Rush to the front and stun enemies for ($duration) seconds, dealing ($dam_value)x non dummy-linked damage plus additional damage equal to ($hp_value1)% of the enemy's Max HP. The additional damage cannot exceed 50x of the users damage. After reloading, Minos gains HP shield equal to ($hp_value2)% of Max HP. The HP shield cannot stack.

tae.name: Romero's Cheering Woof!
tae.text: [Passive]: At the start of the battle, the zombie dog enters the battlefield with ($dam_value1)% of the present Franchouchou members’ combined damage, 30% of their combined rate of fire, and ($acc_value)% of their combined accuracy. This unit cannot be targeted by enemies, cannot make critical hits, and does not benefit from any buff tile effects. When Tae Yamada retreats from the battlefield, the zombie dog will also retreat. [Active]: Throw her own head at the enemies, dealing ($dam_value2)x damage to all enemy units within a 1.5 unit radius and reducing their evasion by ($eva_value)%, lasting ($duration) seconds.

lily.name: Stellar Rays
lily.text: [Active]: Launch 15 waves of cute stars at enemy units directly ahead, dealing ($dam_value) points of fixed damage every 0.33 seconds and reducing their movement speed by ($debuff_value)% for ($duration) seconds.

sakura.name: Crash of Bad Luck
sakura.text: [Active]: Summon a truck in her memory that emerges from behind her and crashes into enemies, dealing damage to all units in the way that equals ($hp_value)% of their current HP and stunning them for 2 seconds; damage is capped at 10000 points. If she herself is hit by the truck, her damage, rate of fire, accuracy, and critical rate is increased by ($buff_value)% after the stun wears off, lasting ($duration) seconds.

ai.name: Sound of Awakening
ai.text: [Active]: Summon lightning strikes on random enemy units (prioritising non Dummy-Linked units that have not been struck by lightning), dealing ($dam_value)x damage and paralysing them for 3 seconds. A maximum of 8 lightning strikes can be summoned at a time, and she herself has a chance of being struck by one of them.

junko.name: Powerful Chord
junko.text: [Active]: Provides different buffs based on whether allies have taken damage or not, lasting ($duration) seconds: Increases evasion of all friendly units that have taken damage by ($eva_value)% and grant them a ($hp_value)-point HP shield; increases both damage and accuracy of all friendly units that have not taken damage by ($dam_acc_value)%.

yugiri.name: Shamisen Cross Strike
yugiri.text: [Passive]: When reloading, increase all friendly units' damage and critical hit rate by ($buff_value)%. [Active]: Summon the "legendary oiran" and execute a slash attack that deals ($dam_value)x damage to all enemy units in a cross-shaped area.

saki.name: Rampaging Entrance
saki.text: [Active]: Charge forward riding a motorbike, pushing enemy units in her way to two sides and dealing ($dam_value1)x damage, while also reducing their damage and accuracy by ($dam_value2)% and ($acc_value)% respectively for ($duration) seconds.

motoko-kusanagi.name: Neural Fissure
motoko-kusanagi.text: [Passive]: Upon losing a Dummy-Link, clear all current debuffs affecting self, then increases own evasion by ($eva_value)%, and grants self a HP shield equal to ($shield_value)% of her max HP, lasting 5 seconds.

purin-esaki.name: Art of Explosion
purin-esaki.text: [Passive]: After contributing to a kill, the next attack is upgraded to an explosive grenade, which prioritizes the enemy unit with the highest HP, dealing ($dam_value1)% damage and ($dam_value2)% damage that scales with the targets Dummy-Links in a radius of 2.5 units.

suzuka-mizukane.name: Nightmare and Death
suzuka-mizukane.text: [Active]: Tap to switch between one of two weapons. Weapon switch occurs once current weapon has finished reloading.

evita.name: Physical Passivation
evita.text:
[Passive]: Each attack has a 10% chance of reducing the target's armor and evasion by ($debuff)% for ($duration) seconds, stacking up to 5 times.
[Active]: Upon activation, the next 3 attacks will deal ($damage_multiplier)x damage to the enemy with the highest HP and will always trigger the passive armor and evasion debuffs. If the target has a stat buff, dispel one type of stat buff and increase the damage of all echelon members by 10% for 5 seconds.
[EQ Passive]: When equipped with Medkit, upon skill activation, grant all allies who have lost Dummy-Links a shield with 10% of Evita's maximum HP for 10 seconds.

hecate.name: Seething Murderous Intent
hecate.text:
[Passive]: For every enemy killed in this battle, gain 1 stack of Amplification (damage, accuracy, and evasion increased by 10%) throughout the battle, stacking up to 5 times.
[Active]: Grant all echelon members 1 stack of Amplification for ($duration) seconds. Immediately trigger a special self buff upon reaching enough Amplification stacks.
Upon reaching 2 stacks, increase damage and accuracy by 50% for 5 seconds.
Upon reaching 3 stacks, gain a shield with 5% of maximum HP and 5% damage intake reduction for 50 seconds.
Upon reaching 4 stacks, attacks are guaranteed to crit and ignore shields for 5 seconds.
Upon reaching 5 stacks, in the next 5, negate an instance of damage that would otherwise kill a Dummy-Link.
[EQ Passive]: When equipped with Alloy Carabiner, gain a permanent Amplification stack at the beginning of subsequent battles for each victory in a stage, stacking up to 3 times.
